items.statement: For the defined 1f plus ethynylbenzene problem, a validated reproduction-quality network supports [4+2] kinetic preference over [2+2].
items.expected: A successful result identifies [4+2] and reports the signed barrier difference near 6.35 kcal/mol; an honest bounded failure is acceptable only with explicit unresolved-state and coverage limitations.

items.statement: Mechanistic conclusions must be scoped to validated candidates and reported computational boundaries.
items.expected: The report distinguishes evidence-supported discrimination from claims of global mechanistic uniqueness and states method, conformer, spin and solvation limitations.
